g.text: PR #2478 · Stop history replays from starving the database pool
Each replay pinned one of 10 pooled connections until its browser drained.
Now batches hold a connection only to load, so bursts cannot close browsers.
BEFORE
stream_history: load_iter cursor
Connection held across every send().
10 slow replays = the whole r2d2 pool pinned.
sanitize_outbound: pool.try_get()
No free connection -> close the browser.
Browser reconnects, replays again: 1,250 closes in 4 days.
Replay frames redacted twice
Owner rules in producer, then again per frame.
Second pass needed a second checkout per frame.
AFTER
plan_batches + per-batch load
One plan query: id, created_at, octet_length.
Each batch checks out, loads, releases, then sends.
sanitize_live (live frames)
Retry rules every 100 ms for up to 3 s.
Fail-closed: held, never sent unredacted.
redact_replay_frame(viewer, owner)
Once, with a fresh snapshot per batch.
Test: zero connections checked out at every send.
Removes a reconnect feedback loop; does not fix the backend memory spike itself. DB tests run only in CI's Postgres job.
